name: refinement-per-defect-domain
body:
Per-defect domain coverage: each identity defect and the tool-boundary requirement carries its own domain entity, which realises its own solution component and reaches its frontend container.

The mapping:
- java-default-package-identity drives domain.entity.java-package, realised by solution.component.java-package-hierarchy, contained by solution.container.java-frontend.
- python-namespace-package-identity drives domain.entity.python-module, realised by solution.component.python-module-identity, contained by solution.container.py-frontend.
- frontend-rooting-from-repo-base drives domain.entity.typescript-package, realised by solution.component.ts-package-rooting, contained by solution.container.ts-frontend.
- absolute-paths-at-tool-boundary drives domain.entity.tool-path-resolution, realised by solution.component.tool-path-resolution, contained by solution.container.opencode-suite.
- the self-ingestion-exclusion requirement drives domain.entity.runtime-artifact, realised by solution.container.go-frontend; its component children go-build-cache and scan-hygiene reach that container.
- repo-relative-file-identity drives domain.entity.source-file, the concrete file entity that realises solution.component.identity-layer.
- fast-project-start drives domain.group.graph-identity, whose realisation is solution.component.identity-layer, solution.component.scan-driver, and the frontend containers.
- the four defect requirements above also drive domain.group.graph-identity as a secondary route, alongside repo-relative-file-identity.

The four defect entities (java-package, python-module, typescript-package, tool-path-resolution) are children of domain.group.graph-identity. Each defect's container connection runs entity → component → contains → container.

Vocabulary gap: requirements.user.graph-consumer stands alone — the authored vocabulary defines Stakeholder ⊃ Requirement alone, so the sub-stakeholder relation lacks an edge form. The User reaches the requirement tree through the tree itself.

Values (canonical-file-identity, module-identity, repo-relative-path) are the driven conceptual values; the domain→component bridge is one entity per defect, because the write-time matrix admits entities as realised-by sources while Values stay the driven values.

Java anchor: java.CallGraphBuilder.main and java.CallGraphBuilder.Collector.emitPkgHierarchy are the real symbols; the bare struct java.CallGraphBuilder lacks a scanned node.
C# FQN rendering: the C# frontend renders the language-rooted csharp.Apg.CsharpFrontend.
